description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the contact module, including help text, entity type alterations, extra field info, menu tab modifications, email handling, and REST resource alterations.

classes.name: ContactHooks
classes.description: Class implementing Drupal hooks for the contact module, including help, entity type, extra fields, menu tabs, mail, and REST resource alterations.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information for the contact module, including usage and configuration details.

methods.name: entityTypeAlter
methods.description: Alters the user entity type to set a link template for contact forms.

methods.name: entityExtraFieldInfo
methods.description: Defines extra form fields for contact messages and user contact settings.

methods.name: menuLocalTasksAlter
methods.description: Hides the contact form tab on user profiles if the user has no email address.

methods.name: mail
methods.description: Handles email message composition for contact form submissions, including auto-replies and notifications.

methods.name: restResourceAlter
methods.description: Alters the REST resource definition for contact messages to specify a custom class.
